tool_input.description: Read Tasks section of UI contract

result:
Frontend-dev phase-03 (US1, Manage tasks) **passed** on attempt 1: all 13 checks passed, with no failures and no open questions.

- **Plan:** I wrote a new test plan, `loops/testing/outputs/001-quickflow/frontend-dev/phase-03-test.md`. It has checks C1–C13 covering acceptance criteria AC-US1-1 to AC-US1-12, and the empty state is checked twice (with no tasks, and with no matches).
- **How it ran:** Playwright MCP (headless) against `/tasks`, on a fresh test database. I created tasks 2–9 straight through the API to set up data for C9–C13, since creating a task through the UI was already checked in C2. Everything checked after that was done through the UI.
- **What was checked:**
  - Empty state and the Add Task action; creating a task (starts as Todo, not archived, times set); `?add=1` opens the form.
  - An empty or 201-character title and a 2,001-character description are rejected. The error text comes from the server, e.g. "size must be between 1 and 200", and doesn't say "title" itself. I counted it as naming the field because it appears under the matching field, as the approved review planned.
  - Status and priority offer only the valid values.
  - Editing all fields saves them and changes the update time.
  - Complete, archive/restore, and delete (the task is then gone from the list, search, archived view and overdue view, and the API returns 404).
  - Search ignores case; filters and sort give the same order as the API; the overdue view excludes tasks due today, Done tasks and archived tasks.
- **Unit tests:** none are configured for the frontend layer, so the unit rule doesn't apply.
- **Console:** the only errors are the three expected 400 responses from the rejected submits.

The verdict is in `loops/testing/state/001-quickflow/verdicts/frontend-dev/phase-03.json` and the report is `loops/testing/outputs/001-quickflow/frontend-dev/phase-03-report.md`. Screenshots and evidence are in `loops/testing/runs/001-quickflow/frontend-dev/phase-03/attempt-1/`. I also added one line to the log in `loops/testing/progress.md`.
